subtitle: Turns the Java Edition second skin layer into real 3D blocks, like the Skin Layers 3D mod for Java!
description:
Every pixel of the hat, jacket, sleeves and pants layers becomes its own block, so hair, hoods and clothes stand out from the body instead of sitting flat on it. The layers use the standard Java skin layout, and the hat sits out from the head at the proper Java size. The game's own skins use the hat layer, so their hair turns 3D too. The jacket, sleeves and pants layers only show on custom skins.

When armor is worn, the layers under it shrink down to fit inside, so they do not poke through.

Use it with the Custom Skin Loader to load your own Java skins with their second layer intact.

Requirements

  • Blueprint Loader, which loads this mod

Install

  1. Close the game, and fully close the Minecraft Launcher if you use it.
  2. Open your Minecraft Dungeons II Paks folder.
    • Steam: Right click the game in your library, then Manage > Browse local files, then open Dungeons\Content\Paks
    • Minecraft Launcher: C:\XboxGames\Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks
    If you picked a different install folder in the Minecraft Launcher, it is Minecraft Dungeons II\Content\Dungeons\Content\Paks inside that folder.
  3. Create a folder called ~mods inside the Paks folder if there is not one already.
  4. Open the zip and move the SkinLayers3D folder inside it into ~mods, so the files end up like this: Paks\~mods\SkinLayers3D\SkinLayers3D_P.pak

Uninstall

Delete the SkinLayers3D folder from ~mods.
